changelog:
Initial release of HengshuiClaw, an intensive pressure escalation system inspired by Hengshui High School discipline.

- Introduces multi-level escalation (PER-T) with distinct motivational tactics for each failure stage.
- Enforces never giving up until every avenue is exhausted; requires different strategies on each retry.
- Automatically activates on specific trigger phrases or when signs of giving up are detected.
- Bans unhelpful or defeatist phrases; mandates detailed tracking of attempted solutions.
- Exit only upon clear completion, meaningful partial progress, or human command.
